QuestInfo.name: Ready to Sail...?
QuestInfo.0: Is it time to head to Victoria Island? Check with Captain #bVasily#k in Southperry.
QuestInfo.1: Monsters have somehow invaded the Sangri-La. It's up to you to get rid of them. Go defeat the #bMano#k in the captain's cabin.
QuestInfo.2: You've defeated the Mano. Now the Sangri-La can head for Victoria Island!

0.0: Now's not a good time. I've got a situation...\r\n#L0##bWhat's wrong?#l\n#k
0.1: I haven't the foggiest notion how this happened, but there are monsters on board! Say, you're an Explorer. Think you can, you know, take care of them?

yes.0: Great! Just hop up those stairs over there to get to the monsters.

no.0: Well, we can't depart until the monsters are gone, and I'm not about to fight them myself.

1.0: Hey, you really did it. Let me just sort out a few things with the ship first, then we'll go.

yes.0: Hop on! Let's boogie on down to Victoria Island! For real, this time!
